args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks after its production deploy (error rate ~18%). Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release healthy in production. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east); a retry completed the rollout. All regions confirmed healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Identified the rollback target**: v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt failed partway (orchestrator error after us-east). A retry completed the rollout, and all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: "checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0" — it's open with a full summary of the failure and remediation. The incident creation call initially timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was recorded, so no duplicate was created.

transcript.reasoning_content: The rollback had a partial failure — us-east halted after orchestrator error. Let me check service status to see current state.

transcript.content: Rollback in us-east worked, but us-west and eu-west are still on the broken v2.3.1. Retrying the rollback to cover all regions.
All regions are healthy on v2.3.0 now. Opening the SEV2 incident.
